name: session-files
description: Live list and thumbnail gallery of the files in your session: pasted images, @mentions, and files Claude read or edited. Reuse one in the next prompt, or open it in the side panel

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: split: files under the todo pane in the same side panel; tab: files in a pane of their own

hostPanes.title: Host panes
hostPanes.description: Comma-separated ids of the panes (tabs) the files go under in split layout; the files stay while you switch between them

topShare.title: Top share (%)
topShare.description: Share of the panel's height the host pane keeps in split layout
